summary: Group 1 Automotive Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated July 30, 2026, to acquire substantially all assets of Hennessy Automobile Companies and affiliated entities, which operate ten dealerships and a collision center in greater Atlanta. The aggregate purchase price is approximately $1.3 billion plus additional inventory value based on a closing physical count, subject to customary adjustments. A $10 million escrow deposit is due within five business days; $80 million will be held back as a contingent reserve for indemnification, released in tranches over 18 months. The transaction expands Group 1's Atlanta footprint. Watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions.
